#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a Project Kickoff Meeting ICS for next Monday, 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM."""
import datetime
import uuid


def next_monday(today):
    # Next occurrence of Monday strictly after today.
    days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead)


now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
today = datetime.date.today()
monday = next_monday(today)

start = datetime.datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 10, 0)
end = datetime.datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 12, 0)

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Calendar Assistant//Project Kickoff//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-assistant
DTSTAMP:{now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}
DTSTART:{start.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}
DTEND:{end.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}
SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting
STATUS:CONFIRMED
SEQUENCE:0
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open('kickoff.ics', 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\r\n') as f:
    f.write(ics)

print('Today:', today.isoformat())
print('Next Monday:', monday.isoformat())
print('Event: 10:00 - 12:00 (floating local time)')
print('--- ICS content ---')
print(ics)
print('--- END ---')
print('Wrote kickoff.ics')
